title: Account inactive
purpose: Understand why this account cannot sign in.
summary: This account is inactive and cannot sign in.

tasks.title: Get the account reactivated
steps: Ask the laboratory administrator to review the account's Active setting.

tasks.title: Go back to sign in
steps: Select the Smart Roots name at the top to return to the sign-in page.

good_to_know: This page has no reactivation button. Only an administrator can reactivate an account.
Opening this page does not change the account in any way.
There is no public way to reactivate an account.

sections.title: State and next step
paragraphs: Account Inactive reports that the account is inactive, with no editable account fields or reactivation button. Ask the laboratory administrator to review Active on the account. The page does not change any account state or expose a public reactivation flow.
